name: Eagle Ford Chisholm Pipeline
researcher_notes: EIA August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 680: Eagle Ford Chisholm Pipeline, Energy Transfer Partners LP, new pipeline, completed 17 Feb 2011, Texas, 83 miles, 20 inch, 300 MMcf/d, intrastate, state authority. An Oil and Gas Journal article from 2010 independently says the first phase is about 83 miles of 20-inch line from DeWitt County to the LaGrange processing plant in Fayette County, with initial capacity of 100 MMcf/d and expansion planned beyond 300. The sheet capacity of 300 follows the EIA figure; initial capacity was 100 MMcf/d. Not found inside the Texas Intrastate System row (P0264): that row is a system aggregate with no endpoints or diameter, and Chisholm is a separately named line, so it is added as its own row. The line carries gas to a processing plant, so it may be a gathering line; marked gathering, reviewer to confirm. Operator name on the sheet follows the ownership team spelling Energy Transfer LP (exact match). Energy Transfer press release page timed out and is not cited. Route not researched; no route found, RouteType left for the routes step. Texas Railroad Commission filing not checked.
